Write a table in the database ----    library(dplyr)   data("mtcars")   mtcars <- as_tibble(mtcars, rownames = "car")   dbWriteTable(con, "mtcars", mtcars)    ## Query the database ----    carsFromDB <- dbReadTable(con, "mtcars")   dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT car, mpg, cyl, hp FROM mtcars WHERE hp>=110")    ## text: drv driver object created ClickHouseHTTP() host name database host (default: "localhost") port port database listening (default: 8123L) dbname name default database (default: "default") user user name (default: "default") password user password (default: "") https logical use HTTPS protocol (default: FALSE) ssl_verifypeer logical verify SSL certificate using HTTPS (default: TRUE) host_path path use host (e.g. "ClickHouse/"): allows connect server behind reverse proxy example use_session logical indicating session created use ClickHouse (default: FALSE) session_timeout timeout seconds (default: 3600L seconds) convert_uint logical: TRUE (default), UInt ClickHouse data types converted following R classes: UInt8 : logical UInt16: Date (using Arrow format dbSendQuery,ClickHouseHTTPConnection,character-method) UInt32: POSIXct (using Arrow format dbSendQuery,ClickHouseHTTPConnection,character-method) extended_headers named list HTTP headers (example: extended_headers=list("X-Authorization"="Bearer <token>") can used OAuth access delegation) reset_handle logical indicating whether force fresh TCP connection request (httr2 fresh_connect curl option). TRUE, connections never reused pool, can help long-running sessions stale connections cause errors (default: FALSE). settings list Clickhouse settings ... parameters passed methods

title: Version 1.1.2
text: CRAN release: 2026-10-02 Declared support dbplyr’s 2nd edition interface (dbplyr_edition()), fixing dplyr::tbl() dbplyr-based verbs previously failed “uses dbplyr’s 1st edition interface, longer supported” #7. Added sql_translation() method .character()/.integer()/ .numeric()/.logical()/.Date()/.POSIXct(), ^, Sys.Date()/Sys.time() sd()/var() translate ClickHouse’s conversion/aggregate functions (toString, toInt64, toFloat64, toUInt8, toDate, toDateTime, pow, today, now, stddevSamp, varSamp) instead dbplyr’s ANSI defaults, ClickHouse doesn’t recognize. (Implemented Claude Code) Added sql_table_analyze() (-op, ClickHouse ANALYZE) db_connection_describe() (shows ClickHouse server/version instead just connection class name) dbplyr methods. (Implemented Claude Code) Added testthat suite auditing dbplyr/ClickHouse SQL compatibility: offline SQL-rendering checks (server needed) plus opt-live round-trip suite (set CLICKHOUSE_TEST_HOST run real server). (Implemented Claude Code)

title: Version 1.1.1
text: Fixed timezone-qualified DateTime columns reported unsupported format = "TabSeparatedWithNamesAndTypes". format = "TabSeparatedWithNamesAndTypes" now uses timezone embedded column’s type (e.g. DateTime('Europe/Paris')) present, falling back session_timezone connection setting otherwise.

title: Version 1.1.0
text: Arrow timestamp conversion now uses session_timezone connection setting #6. Tab-separated DateTime values now match Arrow timestamps session_timezone defined.

title: Version 1.0.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-05-18 Implemented dbColumnInfo() ClickHouseHTTPResult: returns data frame name type columns describing R types query result. Works Arrow TabSeparatedWithNamesAndTypes formats parsing buffered response content without consuming result cursor, dbFetch() can still called afterwards.

title: Version 0.99.0
text: Migrated HTTP backend httr httr2: requests now built using httr2 request pipeline (request() → req_headers() → req_options() → req_perform()). reset_handle parameter dbConnect() now maps httr2/curl fresh_connect option instead former httr::handle_reset(). behaviour unchanged: set TRUE force new TCP connection request rather reusing pooled one. HTTP error responses handled manually (via .query_success()) rather relying httr2’s automatic error raising, preserving existing ClickHouse exception-code detection logic. Minimum R version bumped 4.1 (required native pipe |> used httr2 request pipeline).

title: Version 0.3.5
text: Bug fix (identified corrected Claude): Date columns returned integers using format="Arrow". Newer ClickHouse versions send Date Arrow date32 directly, internal type-casting logic contained Date32 → int32 rule ever intended intermediate step old ClickHouse (sent Date UInt16). applied already correctly typed date32 column, stripped date semantics conversion R, yielding integer instead Date. Fixed rewriting Arrow schema cast helpers (result.R) generate two-step UInt16 → int32 → date32 chain source column actually UInt16, leaving date32 timestamp columns untouched.
